situations.title: NIHSS 신경 사정
situations.tagline: My right arm feels heavy and my words keep coming out wrong.
situations.brief: NIHSS 항목을 순서대로 사정하며 신경 결손의 변화를 추적하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check your strength, so please squeeze both of my hands.
Can you tell me where you are and what month it is?
Follow my finger with just your eyes, please.

situations.title: 혈압 목표 관리
situations.tagline: The monitor keeps beeping — is my blood pressure too high?
situations.brief: 허혈성과 출혈성 뇌졸중의 혈압 목표 차이를 설명하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We're keeping your pressure in a specific range to protect your brain.
The alarm just means we're watching your numbers very closely.
I'm giving a medicine to gently bring the pressure down.
goals: 뇌졸중 유형별 혈압 목표를 쉽게 설명한다

situations.title: 삼킴 전 금식·흡인 예방
situations.tagline: I'm really thirsty — why can't I have any water yet?
situations.brief: 삼킴 평가 전 금식을 유지하고 흡인 위험을 낮추는 이유를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We need to check that you can swallow safely before you drink.
Water could go into your lungs right now, so let's wait.
I can moisten your lips and mouth to help with the dryness.
goals: 삼킴 평가 전 금식의 필요성을 설명한다
흡인 예방을 위한 구강 관리를 제공한다

situations.title: 재관류 후 감시
situations.tagline: They gave me that clot-busting medicine — what should I watch for now?
situations.brief: tPA나 혈전제거 후 출혈 징후와 신경 변화를 집중 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll be checking you often for any new weakness or headache.
Please tell me right away if your headache gets worse.
We're watching closely for any signs of bleeding.
goals: 재관류 후 출혈 징후를 조기에 인지한다

situations.title: 두부 거상·체위
situations.tagline: Why do you keep raising the head of my bed like this?
situations.brief: 뇌관류와 흡인 예방의 균형을 위해 적절한 두부 거상 체위를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Keeping your head up helps protect your lungs while you recover.
This position also helps blood flow to your brain.
Let me know if you feel any discomfort in this position.

situations.title: 의식 변화 관찰
situations.tagline: He seems more drowsy than he was an hour ago — is that normal?
situations.brief: 보호자의 관찰을 반영하며 의식 악화를 조기에 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for telling me — I'll check his level of alertness now.
Small changes matter, so please keep letting me know.
I'm going to wake him and see how he responds.

situations.title: tPA 후 출혈 합병증 감시
situations.tagline: Her headache suddenly got much worse — should I be worried?
situations.brief: tPA 투여 후 신경 악화와 두개내 출혈 징후를 즉시 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: A worsening headache is something we take very seriously here.
I'm checking her neuro exam and calling the physician now.
We may need a scan to rule out bleeding.

situations.title: 대뇌부종 진행 감시
situations.tagline: He's harder to wake up than yesterday — what does that mean?
situations.brief: 악성 대뇌부종의 진행 징후를 감시하고 신경 악화를 조기에 포착하세요.
keyPhrases: Increasing sleepiness can mean the brain is swelling.
I'm doing a full neuro check and updating the team right away.
We're watching his pupils and responses very closely.

situations.title: 혈압 변동 정밀 조절
situations.tagline: His pressure is swinging a lot — do you want me to titrate the nicardipine?
situations.brief: 허혈과 출혈 상황을 구분하며 혈압 변동을 정밀하게 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the target range before we titrate.
Please titrate the nicardipine slowly and recheck in five minutes.
Watch for any drop that could reduce brain perfusion.
goals: 뇌졸중 유형별 목표에 맞춰 혈압을 조절한다
약물 적정을 팀과 함께 안전하게 시행한다

situations.title: 삼킴장애 관리·영양 경로
situations.tagline: If she can't swallow safely, how is she going to eat?
situations.brief: 삼킴장애 환자의 흡인을 예방하며 대체 영양 경로를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: For now, we'll give nutrition through a small feeding tube.
This protects her lungs until her swallowing improves.
A speech therapist will evaluate her swallowing soon.
goals: 흡인 예방을 위한 대체 영양 경로를 설명한다

situations.title: 출혈성 뇌졸중 응고 역전
situations.tagline: He's on warfarin and this is a bleed — should I get the reversal agent ready?
situations.brief: 출혈성 뇌졸중에서 항응고 효과를 신속히 역전하도록 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, let's prepare the reversal agent and vitamin K now.
Draw a coag panel and send it stat.
We need to reverse this quickly to limit the bleeding.
goals: 항응고 역전 약물을 신속히 준비하고 투여한다

situations.title: 혈전제거 후 재관류 관리
situations.tagline: They pulled the clot out — does that mean I'm okay now?
situations.brief: 혈전제거 후 관류를 유지하고 재폐색 징후를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: The procedure went well, but we still need to watch you closely.
Tell me right away if any weakness comes back.
We're keeping your blood flow steady to protect your brain.
goals: 재관류 후 관리 계획을 환자에게 설명한다

situations.title: 발작 동반 관리
situations.tagline: His arm started jerking and he wouldn't respond — what was that?
situations.brief: 뇌졸중 후 발작을 안전하게 관리하고 재발을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: That may have been a seizure, which can happen after a stroke.
I've made him safe and I'm notifying the physician now.
We'll watch him closely and may start a medication to prevent more.
goals: 발작 중 환자 안전을 확보하고 관찰한다
재발 감시와 치료 계획을 가족에게 설명한다

situations.title: 조기 재활·합병증 예방
situations.tagline: Why do I have to move around so soon after a stroke?
situations.brief: 조기 재활과 VTE 및 욕창 예방의 필요성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Moving early helps prevent blood clots and pneumonia.
We'll go slowly and I'll support you the whole time.
Changing position also protects your skin.

situations.title: 이송·영상 조율
situations.tagline: CT wants him for a repeat scan — can we get him ready to travel?
situations.brief: 반복 CT를 위해 안전한 이송을 준비하고 영상팀과 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm his lines and monitor are ready for transport.
I'll bring the portable oxygen and emergency meds.
Can you call CT to confirm they're ready for us?
goals: 안전한 이송을 위한 장비와 인력을 준비한다

situations.title: 악성 대뇌부종 뇌탈출 위기
situations.tagline: You're saying his brain is swelling — can't the surgeons do something right now?
situations.brief: 악성 대뇌부종의 뇌탈출 위기에서 감압수술 필요성을 가족과 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: The swelling is severe, and neurosurgery is being called now.
They may recommend surgery to relieve the pressure.
We're doing everything we can this moment to protect his brain.
goals: 뇌탈출 위기 상황을 가족에게 명확히 전달한다

situations.title: tPA 후 대량 뇌출혈 위기
situations.tagline: His pupil just blew — we need to reverse and call neurosurgery now.
situations.brief: tPA 후 대량 뇌출혈 위기에서 역전과 응급 대응을 즉시 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the tPA and start reversal immediately.
I'm calling neurosurgery and getting him to CT stat.
Let's control his blood pressure right now.

situations.title: 대혈관 급성 악화
situations.tagline: She's crashing neurologically — angio is opening the suite for emergent thrombectomy.
situations.brief: 대혈관 폐색의 급성 악화에서 응급 재관류를 위해 영상팀과 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get her ready for angio immediately.
Confirm her airway and lines before we move.
I'll call report to the neuro-interventional team.
goals: 신경 악화를 즉시 인지하고 응급 재관류로 연계한다

situations.title: 급성 의식저하 기도 위기
situations.tagline: He's not protecting his airway anymore — let's set up to intubate.
situations.brief: 급성 의식저하 환자의 기도를 확보하고 삽관을 신속히 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll get the intubation tray and suction ready.
Let's preoxygenate him and position his airway.
Suction is on and I'm ready to assist.
goals: 기도 확보를 위한 장비를 즉시 준비한다

situations.title: 심각 흡인성폐렴 급변
situations.tagline: His sats are dropping fast and he aspirated — I'm bagging him now.
situations.brief: 흡인성폐렴으로 급격히 악화된 호흡을 즉시 지지하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Suction his airway and let's raise the FiO2.
I'll call respiratory and the physician now.
Keep bagging while we prepare for support.
goals: 흡인 후 급격한 호흡 악화에 즉시 대응한다

situations.title: 광범위 뇌손상 목표·예후 소통
situations.tagline: Please, just tell me the truth — is my husband ever going to wake up?
situations.brief: 광범위 뇌손상 환자의 예후와 치료 목표를 가족과 진솔하게 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I wish I had better news, and I'll be honest with you.
The injury to his brain is very severe.
Let's talk together about what he would have wanted.
goals: 치료 목표 논의를 가족과 함께 진행한다
